en.t: Emperor Domitian is assassinated as a result of a plot by his wife Domitia and two Praetorian prefects. Nerva is then proclaimed as his successor
en.s: Domitian ( də-MISH-ən, -⁠ee-ən; Latin: Domitianus; 24 October 51 – 18 September 96) was Roman emperor from 81 to 96. As the son of Vespasian and the younger brother of Titus, his two predecessors on the throne, he was the last member of the Flavian dynasty. Described by the historian Brian W. Jones as "a ruthless but efficient autocrat", his authoritarian style of ruling put him at sharp odds with the Senate, whose powers he drastically curtailed.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝多米提安遇刺，涅尔瓦继位
zh.s: 多米提安（拉丁语：Domitianus；51年10月24日—96年9月18日）于81年至96年担任罗马皇帝，是韦斯巴芗之子、提图斯之弟，也是弗拉维王朝最后一位皇帝。历史学家布赖恩·W·琼斯称他是“冷酷但高效的专制君主”；他强硬的统治方式与元老院严重冲突，并大幅削弱元老院权力。

en.s: The Battle of Chrysopolis was fought on 18 September 324 between the Roman emperors Constantine I and Licinius near Chrysopolis (modern Üsküdar), opposite Byzantium (modern Istanbul) on the Asiatic shore of the Bosphorus. The battle followed Constantine's victory at the Battle of the Hellespont, where his son Crispus destroyed the Licinian fleet.

zh.s: 324年9月18日，罗马皇帝君士坦丁一世与李锡尼在克里索波利斯附近交战。该地位于博斯普鲁斯海峡亚洲一侧，隔海与拜占庭（今伊斯坦布尔）相望，现为于斯屈达尔。此前，君士坦丁在赫勒斯滂海战中获胜，其子克里斯普斯击毁了李锡尼的舰队。

en.s: The siege of Ansi took place between Goguryeo and Tang forces in Ansi, a fortress in the Liaodong Peninsula, and the culmination of the First campaign in the Goguryeo–Tang War. The confrontation lasted for about three months from 20 June 645 to 18 September 645. The initial phase of combat resulted in the defeat of a Gorguryeo relief force of 150,000 and resulted in the Tang troops laying siege to the fortress.

zh.s: 安市城围城战是高句丽与唐军之间的一场军事交锋，围绕辽东半岛上的安市城展开，也是第一次高句丽-唐战争的最后阶段。这场对峙持续约三个月，从645年6月20日到9月18日。战斗初期，高句丽一支15万人的援军被击败，唐军随后围攻安市城。

en.s: The Battle of Las Babias occurred in the year 795 when the Emir of Cordoba, Hisham I of Córdoba sought to avenge his previous military incursions in 794 against the Kingdom of Asturias under the command of the brothers Abd al-Karim ibn Abd al-Walid ibn Mugaith and Abd al-Malik ibn Abd al-Walid ibn Mugaith.

zh.s: 795年，科尔多瓦埃米尔希沙姆一世派军进攻阿斯图里亚斯王国，由阿卜杜勒·卡里姆·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦利德·伊本·穆盖斯和阿卜杜勒·马利克·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦利德·伊本·穆盖斯兄弟率领，意在报复794年的军事入侵。

en.s: The Battle of Kapetron or Kapetrou was fought between a Byzantine-Georgian army and the Seljuq Turks at the plain of Kapetron (modern Hasankale/Pasinler in northeastern Turkey) in 1048. The event was the culmination of a major raid led by the Seljuq prince Ibrahim Inal into Byzantine-ruled Armenia.

zh.s: 卡佩特隆战役又称卡佩特鲁战役，1048年由拜占庭-格鲁吉亚联军与塞尔柱突厥人在卡佩特隆平原交战，地点在今土耳其东北部哈桑卡莱（帕辛莱尔）。此战是塞尔柱王子易卜拉欣·伊纳尔深入拜占庭统治下亚美尼亚发动大规模袭击的高潮。

en.t: Philip Augustus becomes king of France at the age of fifteen
en.s: Philip II (21 August 1165 – 14 July 1223), also known as Philip Augustus (French: Philippe Auguste), was King of France from 1180 to 1223. His predecessors had been known as kings of the Franks (Latin: rex Francorum), but from 1190 onward, Philip became the first French monarch to style himself "King of France" (rex Francie).

zh.t: 菲利普·奥古斯都十五岁即位为法国国王
zh.s: 菲利普二世（1165年8月21日—1223年7月14日），又称菲利普·奥古斯都（法语：Philippe Auguste），于1180年至1223年担任法兰西国王。他的前任通常自称“法兰克人之王”（拉丁语：rex Francorum）；从1190年起，菲利普成为首位自称“法兰西国王”（rex Francie）的法国君主。

en.s: The Battle of Savra (Albanian: Beteja e Savrës; Serbian: Bitka na Saurskom polju; Turkish: Savra Muharebesi; "Battle on the Saurian field") or the Battle of the Vjosë was fought on 18 September 1385 between Ottoman and much smaller Zetan forces, at the Savra field near Lushnjë (in modern-day southern Albania). The Ottomans were invited by Karl Thopia to support him in his feud against Balša II.

zh.s: 萨夫拉战役也称萨乌里安平原战役或维约萨河战役，于1385年9月18日在萨夫拉平原（今阿尔巴尼亚南部卢什涅附近）爆发。奥斯曼军队与人数少得多的泽塔军队交战。卡尔·托皮亚邀请奥斯曼军队参战，协助自己对付巴尔沙二世。

en.s: The Battle of Chi Lăng Pass was a short skirmish between Vietnamese forces under Prince Lê Lợi and Chinese Ming dynasty army under General Liu Sheng. The battle took place in the Chi Lăng valley, Chi Lăng District, Northeast Vietnam on September 18, 1427. A large Chinese force under the command of Liu Sheng had been dispatched to relieve Wang Tong, who was besieged at Đông Quan in the aftermath of the Battle of Tốt Động – Chúc Động.

zh.s: 支棱关战役是越南黎利王子率领的军队与明朝刘升将军所部之间的一场短暂交战，于1427年9月18日在越南东北部支棱县支棱谷地爆发。刘升率领一支大军前来解围，救援被围困在东关城的王通；此前，明军已在崒洞祝洞战役中失利。

en.s: The siege of Rhodes was a military engagement involving the Knights Hospitaller and Mamluk Sultanate. The Mamluk fleet landed on the island of Rhodes on 10 August 1444, besieging its citadel. Clashes took place on the western walls of the city and at the Mandraki harbor. On 18 September 1444, the Mamluks departed from the island and lifted the siege.

zh.s: 罗得岛围城战是医院骑士团与马穆鲁克苏丹国之间的一场军事交锋。1444年8月10日，马穆鲁克舰队在罗得岛登陆，围攻当地城堡。双方在城市西侧城墙和曼德拉基港附近交战。1444年9月18日，马穆鲁克军队离开该岛，围城结束。

en.s: The Battle of Chojnice (or Battle of Konitz) occurred on 18 September 1454 near the town of Chojnice, between Poland and the Teutonic Knights during the Thirteen Years' War. The battle was won by the Teutonic Knights.

zh.s: 霍伊尼采战役也称科尼茨战役，于1454年9月18日在霍伊尼采镇附近爆发。十三年战争期间，波兰与条顿骑士团在此交战，最终条顿骑士团获胜。

en.t: The expedition of Juan Bautista Pastene makes landfall in San Pedro Bay, southern Chile, claiming the territory for Spain
en.s: Giovanni Battista Pastene (1507–1580) was a Genoese maritime explorer who, while in the service of the Spanish crown, explored the coasts of Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Chile as far south as the archipelago of Chiloé.

zh.t: 胡安·包蒂斯塔·帕斯特内远征队登陆智利南部圣佩德罗湾，宣称该地归属西班牙
zh.s: 乔瓦尼·巴蒂斯塔·帕斯特内（1507—1580）是热那亚海上探险家，效力于西班牙王室期间曾探索巴拿马、哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔、秘鲁和智利沿岸，最远到达奇洛埃群岛。

en.s: The Battle of Stegeborg took place on a meadow near Stegeborg Castle, Sweden on September 18, 1598. It is part of the so-called War against Sigismund, in turn part of the Polish–Swedish Wars. King of Poland and Sweden, Sigismund, tried to put down a rebellion by Duke Charles. The army of King Sigismund III Vasa and Prince Charles met the Stegeborg. Mercenaries king easily stopped of untrained troops the prince and Polish cavalry attack broke down and refused to strike causing panic, during which the enemy suffered heavy losses.

zh.s: 斯泰格堡战役于1598年9月18日在瑞典斯泰格堡城堡附近的一片草地上发生，属于对抗西吉斯蒙德战争，也是波瑞战争的一部分。波兰国王兼瑞典国王西吉斯蒙德试图平定查理公爵的叛乱；西吉斯蒙德三世·瓦萨与查理亲王的军队在斯泰格堡交战。

en.s: The Battle of Mirăslău, or Battle of Miriszló, took place on September 18, 1600, near Miriszló (Romanian: Mirăslău), Transylvania, between the Wallachian troops led by Michael the Brave supported by ethnic Hungarian Szeklers and the troops of Austrian general Giorgio Basta supported by the Hungarian nobility of Transylvania. In 1599, Michael took control of Transylvania after the Battle of Șelimbăr.

zh.s: 米勒斯劳战役也称米里斯洛战役，于1600年9月18日在特兰西瓦尼亚米勒斯劳（罗马尼亚语：Mirăslău）附近爆发。交战双方是勇敢者米哈伊率领的瓦拉几亚军队（有匈牙利族塞凯伊人支持），以及由奥地利将军乔治奥·巴斯塔指挥、得到特兰西瓦尼亚匈牙利贵族支持的军队。1599年，米哈伊在舍林巴尔战役后控制了特兰西瓦尼亚。

en.s: The siege of Nuremberg was a campaign that took place in 1632 about the Imperial City of Nuremberg during the Thirty Years' War. In July 1632, rather than face the numerically superior combined Imperial and Catholic League army under the command of Albrecht von Wallenstein and Bavarian Elector Maximilian I, Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden ordered a tactical retreat into the city of Nuremberg.

zh.s: 纽伦堡围城战是三十年战争期间围绕帝国自由城市纽伦堡展开的一场军事行动，发生于1632年。1632年7月，瑞典国王古斯塔夫·阿道夫不愿正面迎战由阿尔布雷希特·冯·瓦伦斯坦和巴伐利亚选帝侯马克西米利安一世率领、人数占优的帝国与天主教联盟联军，于是下令撤入纽伦堡。

en.s: The Battle of Aldbourne Chase was a relatively small battle of the First English Civil War that occurred on 18 September 1643. In the skirmish the Royalist cavalry led by Prince Rupert attacked the extended columns of the Parliamentarian army of the Earl of Essex at Aldbourne Chase, Wiltshire, as he was attempting to get his army to London.

zh.s: 第一次英国内战期间，1643年9月18日爆发了规模较小的奥尔德伯恩蔡斯战役。埃塞克斯伯爵正试图率议会军前往伦敦，鲁珀特亲王率领的保王党骑兵在威尔特郡奥尔德伯恩蔡斯袭击了拉长行军的议会军纵队。

en.s: The Battle of Montgomery took place during the First English Civil War of 1642–1646. On 17 September 1644, a Parliamentarian force commanded by Sir John Meldrum advanced to engage a Royalist army led by Lord Byron which was besieging Montgomery Castle in mid Wales. The battle was fought the next day. After the Royalists gained an initial advantage, the Parliamentarians counter-attacked and destroyed Byron's army.

zh.s: 蒙哥马利战役发生于1642年至1646年的第一次英国内战期间。1644年9月17日，约翰·梅尔德鲁姆爵士率议会军前往迎战拜伦勋爵率领的保王党军；后者当时正在围攻威尔士中部的蒙哥马利城堡。战斗于次日打响。保王党一度占优，但议会军随后反击，击溃了拜伦的军队。

en.s: The Battle of Bhangani was fought between Guru Gobind Singh's army and Bhim Chand (Kahlur) of Bilaspur on 18 September 1686 or 1688, at Bhangani near Paonta Sahib. An alliance of Rajput Rajas of the Shivalik Hills participated in the engagement on behalf of Bhim Chand of Bilaspur State's side, including the states of Garhwal and Kangra.

zh.s: 邦加尼战役发生于1686年或1688年9月18日，地点在保恩塔萨希卜附近的邦加尼。交战双方是古鲁·戈宾德·辛格的军队与比拉斯布尔王国卡卢尔邦的比姆·钱德。湿婆利克山脉一带的拉杰普特诸侯结成联盟，站在比姆·钱德一方参战，其中包括加瓦尔和康格拉诸邦。

en.s: The Battle of Leuze was a minor Cavalry engagement of the Nine Years' War that took place on 18 September 1691 between a detachment of French and a slightly superior Allied force. Marshal Luxembourg had been informed that William III of Orange had left for England, in the supposition that the campaign of 1691 was at its end. He was also informed that Marshal Waldeck, who was left in charge, was preparing to retire into winter quarters. Luxembourg was near Tournai and sent out a reconnaissance under Marsilly, from whom he learned that the main body of the Allied army was retreating, leaving a rear-guard of cavalry at Leuze.

zh.s: 勒兹战役是九年战争中的一次小规模骑兵交战，发生于1691年9月18日，交战双方是法军一支分队和人数稍多的盟军。卢森堡元帅得知奥兰治的威廉三世已前往英格兰，以为1691年的战事已经结束；他还听说留守的瓦尔德克元帅正准备率军进入冬季驻地。卢森堡当时在图尔奈附近，他派马西伊率侦察队出发。马西伊发现盟军主力正在撤退，只留下骑兵后卫驻守勒兹。

en.s: The Battle of Zeytinburnu was a naval battle in September 1695 in which the Ottoman fleet under the command of Mezzomorto inflicted a heavy defeat on the fleet of the Republic of Venice off the coast of Lesbos.

zh.s: 1695年9月，梅佐莫尔托率领的奥斯曼舰队在莱斯沃斯岛沿岸重创威尼斯共和国舰队。

en.s: The siege of Ciudad Rodrigo was a successful siege of the Spanish city of Ciudad Rodrigo, between 18 September and 4 October 1707, in which a Franco-Spanish army under command of Alexandre Maître, Marquis de Bay conquered the city. Ciudad Rodrigo had been besieged and taken on 25 May 1706 by 40.000 Portuguese, Dutch and English soldiers under command of Henri de Massue, Earl of Galway and António Luís de Sousa, 2nd Marquis of Minas.

zh.t: 西乌达德罗德里戈围城战（1707年）
zh.s: 1707年9月18日至10月4日，法西联军在亚历山大·梅特尔、贝侯爵指挥下成功围攻西乌达德罗德里戈并夺取该城。1706年5月25日，西乌达德罗德里戈曾被加尔韦伯爵亨利·德·马苏和第二代米纳斯侯爵安东尼奥·路易斯·德·索萨指挥的4万名葡萄牙、荷兰和英国士兵围攻并攻占。

en.s: The Kanzhal War (Kabardian: Къэнжал зауэ; Crimean Tatar: Къанжал дженки) or Crimean-Circassian War of 1708 was military conflict in 1708 fought between Circassians led by Kurghoqo Hatokhshoqo and Crimean Khanate alongside its allies led by Qaplan I Giray, which resulted in Circassian victory. It played a big role in decreasing foreign influence in Circassia. In 2013, the Russian Academy of Sciences described the battle as "an important event in the history of Circassians".

zh.s: 1708年坎扎尔战争（卡巴尔达语：Къэнжал зауэ；克里米亚鞑靼语：Къанжал дженки），又称克里米亚-切尔克斯战争，是切尔克斯人对抗克里米亚汗国及其盟友的一场军事冲突。切尔克斯人由库尔戈科·哈托赫舒科率领，对方由卡普兰一世·吉雷率领，最终切尔克斯人获胜。此战大幅削弱了外国对切尔克斯的影响。俄罗斯科学院于2013年称其为“切尔克斯人历史上的重要事件”。

en.s: The Treaty of Belgrade, also known as the Belgrade Peace, was a peace treaty between the Habsburg Monarchy and Ottoman Empire, that was signed on September 18, 1739, in Belgrade (modern Serbia), thus ending the Austro-Turkish War (1737–1739). Agreed territorial changes were substantial, and also favorable for the Ottoman side, since Habsburgs had to cede three regions: the Banat of Craiova (modern Oltenia), the Kingdom of Serbia with Belgrade, and Bosnian section of Posavina, thus placing the newly defined Habsburg-Ottoman border on the rivers Sava and Danube.

zh.s: 《贝尔格莱德条约》也称《贝尔格莱德和约》，是哈布斯堡君主国与奥斯曼帝国之间的和平条约，于1739年9月18日在贝尔格莱德（今塞尔维亚）签署，结束了1737年至1739年的奥土战争。条约确定的领土变更幅度很大，也对奥斯曼一方有利：哈布斯堡王朝须交出克拉约瓦巴纳特（今奥尔特尼亚）、包括贝尔格莱德在内的塞尔维亚王国，以及波萨维纳的波斯尼亚部分地区。此后，双方新划定的边界沿萨瓦河和多瑙河延伸。

en.t: French and Indian War: The Articles of Capitulation of Quebec are signed
en.s: The Articles of Capitulation of Quebec were agreed upon between Jean-Baptiste Nicolas Roch de Ramezay, King's Lieutenant, Admiral Sir Charles Saunders, and General George Townshend on behalf of the French and British crowns during the Seven Years' War. They were signed on 18 September 1759, shortly after British victory in the Battle of the Plains of Abraham.

zh.t: 法印战争：魁北克投降条款签署
zh.s: 七年战争期间，魁北克投降条款由法方国王副官让-巴蒂斯特·尼古拉·罗克·德·拉梅泽、英国海军上将查尔斯·桑德斯爵士和乔治·汤森德将军代表法英两国王室协商达成。条款于1759年9月18日签署，时间紧接着英国在亚伯拉罕平原战役中获胜之后。

en.s: The Battle of Neuensund was a smaller battle at Neuensund of the Seven Years' War between Swedish and Prussian forces fought on September 18, 1761. The Swedish force under the command of Jacob Magnus Sprengtporten managed to rout the Prussian forces commanded by Wilhelm Sebastian von Belling.

zh.s: 七年战争期间，瑞典军队与普鲁士军队于1761年9月18日在诺伊恩松德交战。这是一场规模较小的战斗。雅各布·马格努斯·斯普伦波特指挥的瑞典军队击溃了威廉·塞巴斯蒂安·冯·贝林指挥的普鲁士军队。

en.s: The Siege of Darwar was a 29 week siege of the fort at Dharwad in 1790 and 1791, then near the frontier, between the Kingdom of Mysore and the Maratha Empire. The Marathas, assisted by forces of the British East India Company, began the siege on 18 September 1790 and resulted with the surrender of the Mysorean garrison on 3 April 1791.

en.s: The Battle of Coron (18 September 1793) was fought between Royalist and Republican French forces near Coron during the War in the Vendée. A Republican division from Saumur led by Antoine Joseph Santerre beat Royalist Vendeans at Doué-la-Fontaine on 15 September and at Vihiers on the 17th. However, on 18 September Santerre's division blundered into an ambush between Vihiers and Coron set by Louis Marie de Lescure and Dominique Piron. The Republican column was routed and lost all its artillery. A few days later, a flanking Republican division under Charles François Duhoux was beaten in the Battle of Pont-Barré.

zh.s: 1793年9月18日，旺代战争期间，保王派与共和派法军在科龙附近交战。9月15日，桑泰尔率领的萨莫尔共和军师在杜埃拉丰泰击败旺代保王派，17日又在维耶尔获胜。但18日，桑泰尔的部队在维耶尔与科龙之间误入莱斯屈尔和皮龙设下的埋伏。共和军纵队溃败，所有火炮都被丢弃。几天后，杜乌指挥的共和军侧翼部队又在蓬巴雷战役中被击败。

zh.s: 斯普里蒙战役也称乌尔特河战役，于1794年9月18日爆发，是第一次反法同盟战争中的一场战斗。交战双方是让-巴蒂斯特·茹尔当将军指挥的法国革命军桑布尔-默兹军团一支部队，以及弗朗索瓦·塞巴斯蒂安·夏尔·约瑟夫·德·克鲁瓦伯爵指挥的奥地利军队左翼。

en.s: The Second Battle of Kehl occurred on 18 September 1796, when General Franz Petrasch's Austrian and Imperial troops stormed the French-held bridgehead over the Rhine river. en.s: The Battle of Mannheim (18 September 1799) was fought between a Habsburg Austrian army commanded by Archduke Charles, Duke of Teschen and a Republican French army under Jacques Léonard Muller. Most of the French Army of the Rhine had retreated to the west bank of the Rhine River, leaving the division of Antoine Laroche Dubouscat to hold Mannheim on the east bank. Despite assistance by Michel Ney, Laroche's division was beaten and driven out of the city when attacked by Charles and a much superior force.

zh.s: 1799年9月18日，特申公爵、哈布斯堡王朝大公查理率领奥地利军队，与雅克·莱昂纳尔·米勒指挥的共和派法军在曼海姆交战。法军莱茵军团大部已撤到莱茵河西岸，只留下安托万·拉罗什·迪布斯卡指挥的师守卫东岸的曼海姆。尽管米歇尔·内伊前来支援，拉罗什的部队仍在查理率领的优势兵力进攻下战败，被赶出城外。

en.s: The Action of 18 September 1810 was a naval battle fought between British Royal Navy and French Navy frigates in the Indian Ocean during the Napoleonic Wars. The engagement was one of several between rival frigate squadrons contesting control of the French island base of Île de France, from which French frigates had raided British trade routes during the war. The action came in the immediate aftermath of the Battle of Grand Port, in which four British frigates had been lost, and just four days after a fifth British frigate had been captured and subsequently recaptured in the Action of 13 September 1810.

zh.s: 拿破仑战争期间，英国皇家海军与法国海军的护卫舰于1810年9月18日在印度洋交战。这是双方护卫舰分舰队争夺法属岛屿基地法兰西岛控制权的一系列交战之一；法国护卫舰曾以该岛为基地袭击英国商船航线。此次交战紧接着大港海战之后，当时英国损失了四艘护卫舰；而就在四天前，英国的第五艘护卫舰在1810年9月13日的海战中先被俘，随后又被夺回。

en.s: The Chilean War of Independence was a war between pro-independence Chilean criollos seeking political and economic independence from Spain and royalist criollos supporting continued allegiance to the Captaincy General of Chile and membership of the Spanish Empire. Traditionally, the beginning of the war is dated as September 18, 1810. Depending on what terms are used to define its end, it lasted until 1821, when royalist forces were defeated by José de San Martín; or until 1826, when the last Spanish troops surrendered and the Chiloé Archipelago was incorporated to the Chilean republic.

zh.s: 智利独立战争是支持独立的智利克里奥尔人与保王派克里奥尔人之间的战争。前者寻求从西班牙获得政治和经济独立，后者则支持继续效忠智利都督辖区并留在西班牙帝国之内。传统上，战争被认为始于1810年9月18日。根据对战争结束的界定不同，战争可能于1821年结束，当时保王派军队被何塞·德·圣马丁击败；也可能延续到1826年，直到最后一批西班牙军队投降、奇洛埃群岛并入智利共和国。

en.s: The invasion of Java was a successful British amphibious operation against Java in the Dutch East Indies between August and September 1811 during the Napoleonic Wars. en.s: The Battle of Castelfidardo was a battle of the Expedition of the Thousand that took place on 18 September 1860, at Castelfidardo, a small town in the Marche region of Italy. It was fought between the Sardinian army - acting as the driving force in the war for Italian unification, against the Papal States. On 7 September, Cavour, Prime Minister of Piedmont, sent an ultimatum to the Pope demanding that he dismiss his foreign troops. When he failed to do this, 35,000 troops crossed the border on 11 September, with General Cialdini advancing along the Adriatic coast and General Della Rocca leading another troop across Umbria.

A French expedition to Fashoda on the White Nile sought to gain control of the Upper Nile river basin and thereby exclude Britain from Sudan.

zh.t: 法绍达事件引发英法之间最后一次战争危机
zh.s: 法绍达事件又称法绍达危机（法语：Crise de Fachoda），是英国和法国在东非争夺殖民地的冲突高潮，发生于1898年7月10日至11月3日。法国远征队前往白尼罗河畔的法绍达，试图控制上尼罗河流域，从而把英国势力排除在苏丹之外。

loc: 朝鲜帝国仁川至首尔（今韩国）

en.s: The Gyeongin Railway opened its first section between Noryangjin and Incheon on September 18, 1899. The mainline connected the capital region with the port, and was later extended across the Han River toward Seoul.

zh.t: 京仁铁路首段在朝鲜开通
zh.s: 京仁铁路首段于1899年9月18日开通，连接鹭梁津和仁川。铁路主线将首都地区与港口连接起来，后来又跨过汉江延伸至首尔。

en.s: A typhoon struck Hong Kong on September 18, 1906, devastating the harbour and causing extensive loss of life. The storm's rapid arrival left little time for warning; estimates of the death toll vary between historical accounts.

zh.s: 1906年9月18日，台风袭击香港，重创港口并造成大量人员伤亡。风暴来得很快，几乎没有留下预警时间；不同历史资料对死亡人数的估计各不相同。

en.t: In Washington, D.C., George Owen Squier demonstrated the first system to allow multiplexing of telephone transmissions, sending a message between two laboratories of the U.S. Signal Corps
en.s: George Owen Squier (March 21, 1865 – March 24, 1934) was an American general, scientist, and inventor best known for inventing and popularizing what today is called Muzak.

zh.t: 乔治·欧文·斯奎尔演示电话传输复用系统
zh.s: 乔治·欧文·斯奎尔（1865年3月21日—1934年3月24日）是美国将军、科学家和发明家，最知名的贡献是发明并推广了后来称为背景音乐的Muzak。

en.s: Pyotr Arkadyevich Stolypin (Russian: Пётр Арка́дьевич Столы́пин, IPA: [pʲɵtr ɐrˈkadʲjɪvʲɪtɕ stɐˈlɨpʲɪn]; 14 April [O.S. 2 April] 1862 – 18 September [O.S. 5 September] 1911) was a Russian statesman who served as the third prime minister and the interior minister of the Russian Empire from 1906 until his assassination in 1911. Known as a reformer of Russian society and the economy, he initiated reforms which were halted by his assassination.

zh.s: 彼得·阿尔卡季耶维奇·斯托雷平于1911年9月18日逝世。他是俄罗斯帝国政治家，1906年至1911年担任第三任首相兼内政大臣，后遭暗杀身亡。他被视为俄罗斯社会和经济改革者，其改革也因遇刺而中断。

en.t: The Saturday Evening Post publishes the short story "Extricating Young Gussie" by P.G. Wodehouse, featuring the first appearance of Bertie Wooster and his valet Jeeves
en.s: The Saturday Evening Post is an American magazine published six times a year. It was first published in 1821, and published weekly from 1897 until 1963. It was published every other week until 1969. From the 1920s to the 1960s, it was one of the most widely circulated and influential magazines among the American middle class, with fiction, nonfiction, cartoons, and features that reached two million homes every week.

zh.t: 《星期六晚邮报》刊登P·G·伍德豪斯短篇小说《替小古西解围》，伯蒂·伍斯特和仆人吉夫斯首次登场
zh.s: 《星期六晚邮报》是美国杂志，每年出版6期。该刊创办于1821年，1897年至1963年每周出版，之后至1969年每两周出版一次。20世纪20年代至60年代，它是美国中产阶级中发行最广、影响力最大的杂志之一，每周以小说、非虚构作品、漫画和专题内容触达200万户家庭。

en.s: The Battle of Dobro Pole, also known as the Breakthrough at Dobro Pole in Bulgarian (Bulgarian: Пробив при Добро Поле, Probiv Pri Dobro Pole), (Serbian: Битка код Доброг Поља, Bitka Kod Dobrog Polja), (Greek: Μάχη του Ντόμπρο Πόλε, Máchi tou Dómbro Póle), was a World War I battle, fought between 15 and 18 September 1918. The battle was fought in the initial stage of the Vardar Offensive, in the Balkans Theatre. On September 15, a combined force of Serbian, French and Greek troops attacked the Bulgarian-held trenches in Dobro Pole ("Good Field"), at the time part of the Kingdom of Serbia (present day Republic of Macedonia).

zh.s: 多布罗波列战役也称“多布罗波列突破战”，发生于第一次世界大战期间的1918年9月15日至18日，是瓦尔达尔攻势在巴尔干战场初期的一场战斗。9月15日，塞尔维亚、法国和希腊联军进攻多布罗波列由保加利亚军队把守的战壕。当时该地属于塞尔维亚王国（今北马其顿共和国）。

en.s: The Battle of Épehy was a battle of the First World War fought on 18 September 1918, involving the British Fourth Army (under the command of General Henry Rawlinson) against German outpost positions in front of the Hindenburg Line.The village of Épehy was captured on 18 September by the 12th (Eastern) Division.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，英国第四集团军于1918年9月18日与兴登堡防线前方的德军前哨阵地交战，罗林森将军担任英军指挥官。当天，英国第12（东部）师攻占埃佩希村。

en.s: The Aunus expedition (Finnish: Aunuksen retkikunta; Swedish: Aunus-expeditionen) was an attempt by Finnish volunteers to occupy parts of East Karelia in 1919, during the Russian Civil War. Aunus is the Finnish name for Olonets Karelia. This expedition was one of many Finnic "kinship wars" (heimosodat) fought against forces of Soviet Russia after the Russian Revolution of 1917 and during the Russian Civil War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1919年俄国内战期间，芬兰志愿者发动奥努斯远征，试图占领东卡累利阿的部分地区。奥努斯是芬兰语中对奥洛涅茨卡累利阿的称呼。这次远征是1917年俄国革命后、俄国内战期间，芬兰人针对苏俄势力发动的多场“亲族战争”之一。

en.s: The Great Offensive (Turkish: Büyük Taarruz) was the largest and final military operation of the Turkish War of Independence, fought between the Turkish Armed Forces loyal to the government of the Grand National Assembly of Turkey, and the Kingdom of Greece, ending the Greco-Turkish War. The offensive began on 26 August 1922 with the Battle of Dumlupınar.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 大攻势（土耳其语：Büyük Taarruz）是土耳其独立战争中最大、也是最后一次军事行动。交战双方是效忠土耳其大国民议会政府的土耳其武装部队与希腊王国。攻势于1922年8月26日以杜姆卢珀纳尔战役打响，最终结束希土战争。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Tatarbunary Uprising (Romanian: Răscoala de la Tatarbunar) was a peasant revolt that took place on 15–18 September 1924, in and around the town of Tatarbunary in the Bugeac, Romania (now Odesa Oblast, Ukraine). Inspired by Bolshevik ideals and supported by the newly-formed Soviet Union, it was led by a pro-Soviet revolutionary committee which called for the creation of a "Moldavian Soviet Republic" and an end to the "Romanian occupation" of Bessarabia.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 塔塔尔布纳雷起义是一次农民起义，于1924年9月15日至18日在比萨拉比亚布贾克地区的塔塔尔布纳雷镇及周边爆发；该地当时属于罗马尼亚，如今位于乌克兰敖德萨州。起义受到布尔什维克思想影响，并得到新成立的苏联支持。亲苏革命委员会领导起义，呼吁建立“摩尔达维亚苏维埃共和国”，结束其所称的比萨拉比亚“罗马尼亚占领”。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The U.S. ends its military occupation of the Dominican Republic, after invading in May 1916 to force the Dominican government to pay its debts to European creditors
en.s: The Military Government of Santo Domingo (Spanish: Gobierno Militar de Santo Domingo) was a provisional military government established during the American occupation of the Dominican Republic that lasted from May 15, 1916 to September 18, 1924. The United States aimed to force the Dominicans to repay their large debts to European creditors, whose governments threatened military intervention. On May 13, 1916, Rear Admiral William B.

zh.t: 美国结束对多米尼加共和国的军事占领
zh.s: 圣多明各军事政府（西班牙语：Gobierno Militar de Santo Domingo）是美国占领多米尼加共和国期间设立的临时军事政府，存续时间为1916年5月15日至1924年9月18日。美国发动占领，意在迫使多米尼加偿还对欧洲债权国的大笔债务；这些国家曾威胁进行军事干预。

en.s: Japanese military personnel staged an explosion beside the South Manchuria Railway near Mukden, now Shenyang, on September 18, 1931. Japan blamed Chinese forces and used the incident as a pretext for its invasion of Manchuria.

zh.s: 1931年9月18日，日本军方人员在沈阳（当时称奉天）附近的南满铁路旁制造爆炸。日本随后指责中国军队所为，并以此为借口入侵中国东北。

en.s: The Empire of Japan's Kwantung Army invaded the Manchuria region of China on 18 September 1931, immediately following the Mukden incident, a false flag event staged by Japanese military personnel as a pretext to invade. At the war's end in February 1932, the Japanese established the puppet state of Manchukuo.

zh.s: 1931年9月18日，日本帝国关东军在九一八事变后入侵中国东北。该事变是日本军方策划的假旗行动，意在为入侵制造借口。战争于1932年2月结束时，日本在当地建立了傀儡政权满洲国。

en.t: Third encirclement campaign against the Jiangxi Soviet
en.s: The third encirclement campaign (Chinese: 第三次围剿) against Jiangxi Soviet was the third campaign launched by the Chinese Nationalist Government in the hope of destroying the Red Army in Jiangxi. It was launched less than a month after the previous campaign failed. However, this encirclement was repelled by the Red Army's third counter-encirclement campaign at the Central Soviet (Chinese: 中央苏区第三次反围剿), also called as the third counter-encirclement campaign at the Central Revolutionary Base (Chinese: 中央革命根据地第三次反围剿).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 中国国民政府为摧毁江西红军而发动了第三次围剿，这是针对中央苏区的第三次围剿行动。此次进攻在上一次围剿失败不到一个月后发动，但被红军的第三次反围剿行动击退。该行动也称“中央苏区第三次反围剿”或“中央革命根据地第三次反围剿”。

en.t: The body of actress Peg Entwistle is discovered by police, two days after her suicide by jumping off of the Hollywoodland sign
en.s: Millicent Lilian "Peg" Entwistle (5 February 1908 – 16 September 1932) was a British stage and screen actress. She began her stage career in 1925, appearing in several Broadway productions. She appeared in only one film, Thirteen Women (1932), which was released posthumously. Entwistle gained notoriety after she jumped to her death from atop the 'H' on the Hollywoodland Sign in September 1932, at the age of 24.

zh.t: 警方发现女演员佩格·恩特威斯尔的遗体，她两天前从好莱坞地标标志跳下自杀
zh.s: 米利森特·莉莲·“佩格”·恩特威斯尔（1908年2月5日—1932年9月16日）是英国舞台和银幕演员。她于1925年开始舞台生涯，参演过多部百老汇制作；她只出演过一部电影《十三个女人》（1932年），该片在她去世后上映。1932年9月，她从好莱坞地标标志字母“H”顶部跳下身亡，年仅24岁，因此声名大噪。

en.s: The Battle of Kobryń was one of the battles of the Invasion of Poland. It was fought between 14 and 18 September 1939, between the German XIX Panzer Corps of General Heinz Guderian and the improvised Polish 60th Infantry Division "Kobryn" of Colonel Adam Epler. It was fought concurrently with the Battle of Brześć Litewski.

zh.s: 科布林战役是德国入侵波兰期间的一场战斗，于1939年9月14日至18日爆发。交战双方是海因茨·古德里安将军指挥的德国第十九装甲军，以及波兰亚当·埃普勒上校临时编组的第60步兵师“科布林师”。该战役与布热希奇-利特夫斯基战役同时进行。

en.s: Operation Anglo was a British Commando raid on the island of Rhodes during the Second World War. The raid was carried out by eight men of the Special Boat Section (SBS) assisted by four Greeks. In September 1942 their mission was to attack two airfields on the island of Rhodes. The German and Italian bombers based there were being used to attack Royal Navy convoys.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，英国突击队在罗得岛发动“安格洛”袭击行动。执行行动的是8名特种舟艇部队队员，另有4名希腊人协助。1942年9月，他们奉命攻击岛上的两座机场；驻扎在那里的德国和意大利轰炸机正用于袭击英国皇家海军的护航船队。

en.s: The Battle of Arracourt was a major clash between U.S. and German armored forces near the town of Arracourt, Lorraine, France, between 18–29 September 1944, during World War II. As part of a counteroffensive against recent U.S. advances in France, the German 5th Panzer Army had as its objective the recapture of Lunéville and the elimination of the U.S. XII Corps bridgehead over the Moselle River at Dieulouard. With local superiority in troops and tanks, the Germans anticipated quick defeat of the defending Combat Command A (CCA) of the U.S. 4th Armored Division.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，美国与德国装甲部队于1944年9月18日至29日在法国洛林阿拉库尔镇附近展开大规模交战。作为对美军近期在法国推进的反攻行动的一部分，德国第五装甲集团军计划夺回吕内维尔，并消灭美军第十二军在迪厄卢阿尔附近跨越摩泽尔河建立的桥头堡。德军在当地拥有兵力和坦克优势，因此预计能迅速击败负责防守的美国第四装甲师A战斗指挥部。

en.t: World War II: Operation Market Garden results in the liberation of Eindhoven
en.s: Operation Market Garden was an Allied military operation during the Second World War, fought in the German-occupied Netherlands from 17 to 25 September 1944. Its objective was to create a salient spanning 62 miles (100 km) into German territory with a bridgehead over the Nederrijn (Lower Rhine River), creating an Allied invasion route into northern Germany.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：市场花园行动解放埃因霍温
zh.s: 市场花园行动是第二次世界大战期间盟军在德占荷兰发动的一次军事行动，持续于1944年9月17日至25日。行动目标是在德军境内推进62英里（100公里），并在下莱茵河架设桥头堡，为盟军入侵德国北部开辟通道。

en.s: The Battle of Xiangshuikou (Chinese: 响水口战斗) was fought between the nationalists and the communists in northern Jiangsu during the Chinese Civil War in the immediate post-World War II era, and resulted in a communist victory.

zh.s: 响水口战斗发生于第二次世界大战刚结束后，是中国内战期间国民党军与共产党军队在苏北的一场交战，最终共产党一方获胜。

en.s: The National Security Act of 1947 (Pub.L. 80-253, 61 Stat. 495, enacted July 26, 1947) is a law enacting major restructuring of the United States government's military and intelligence agencies following World War II. The majority of the provisions of the act took effect on September 18, 1947, the day after the Senate confirmed James Forrestal as the first secretary of defense.
en.n: This entry records the entry into force, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1947年《国家安全法》（公法第80-253号，61《美国法典汇编》495，1947年7月26日颁布）对二战后的美国军事和情报机构进行了重大重组。该法大部分条款于1947年9月18日生效，也就是参议院确认詹姆斯·福里斯特尔为首任国防部长的次日。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的生效日期。

en.s: The annexation of Hyderabad (code-named Operation Polo) was a military operation launched in September 1948 that resulted in the annexation of the princely state of Hyderabad by India, which was dubbed a "police action". At the time of partition of India in 1947, the princely states of India, who in principle had self-government within their territories, were subject to subsidiary alliances with the British, which gave control of external relations to the British.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 印度于1948年发动“波罗行动”，最终吞并海得拉巴土邦。这次军事行动被称为“警察行动”。1947年印度分治时，印度各土邦原则上可在自己的领土内自治，但与英国保持附属关系，由英国控制其对外关系。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Madiun Affair (Indonesian: Peristiwa Madiun, lit. 'Madiun Event'), also known as the 1948 PKI Rebellion (Pemberontakan PKI 1948) or the PKI Madiun Rebellion (Pemberontakan PKI Madiun), was an armed conflict between the Indonesian government and the left-wing People's Democratic Front (FDR), during the Indonesian National Revolution. The conflict began on September 18, 1948, in Madiun, East Java, and ended three months later when most FDR leaders and members were detained and executed by TNI forces.

zh.s: 茉莉芬事件也称“1948年印尼共产党叛乱”或“茉莉芬印尼共产党叛乱”，是印度尼西亚民族革命期间，印度尼西亚政府与左翼人民民主阵线之间的武装冲突。冲突于1948年9月18日在东爪哇省茉莉芬爆发，三个月后，大部分人民民主阵线领导人和成员被印尼国民军拘捕并处决，冲突由此结束。

en.t: Battle of the Pusan Perimeter ends
en.s: United Nations forces mounted a full-scale breakout from the Pusan Perimeter in southeastern Korea on September 18, 1950. North Korean units were retreating north, bringing the weeks-long defensive battle around Busan to an end.
en.n: The UN breakout began before September 18; this entry marks the battle's final day.

zh.t: 釜山环形防御圈战役结束
zh.s: 1950年9月18日，联合国军在朝鲜半岛东南部的釜山环形防御圈发动全面突围。朝鲜人民军部队正向北撤退，这场围绕釜山持续数周的防御战也随之结束。
zh.n: 联合国军的突围行动早于9月18日开始；本条记录采用战役最后一天。

en.t: TV Tupi Difusora, the first television station to broadcast in Brazil, begins transmissions on Channel 3 in São Paulo
en.s: Rede Tupi (Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈʁedʒi tuˈpi]; in English, Tupi Network) was a Brazilian commercial terrestrial television network. Its flagship station, located in the city of São Paulo, was the first TV station to operate in the country, being inaugurated on 18 September 1950 by journalist Assis Chateaubriand. It was owned by Diários Associados, one of the largest media conglomerates of the 20th century, owner of several newspapers, magazines, and radio stations.

zh.t: 巴西首家电视台Tupi Difusora开播
zh.s: Tupi电视网位于圣保罗的旗舰电视台于1950年9月18日开播，是巴西第一家投入运营的电视台。该台由记者阿西斯·沙托布里昂创办，隶属于Diários Associados集团；该集团是20世纪规模最大的传媒集团之一，拥有多家报纸、杂志和广播电台。

en.t: Finnish president J. K. Paasikivi becomes the first Western head of state to be awarded the highest honor of the Soviet Union, the Order of Lenin
en.s: Juho Kusti Paasikivi (27 November 1870 – 14 December 1956) was a Finnish politician who served as the president of Finland from 1946 to 1956. Representing the Finnish Party until its dissolution in 1918 and then the National Coalition Party, he previously served as senator, member of parliament (1907–1909, 1910–1914), envoy to Stockholm (1936–1939) and Moscow (1940–1941), and Prime Minister of Finland (1918 and 1944–1946).

en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 18 September 1994. The Swedish Social Democratic Party remained the largest party in the Riksdag, winning 161 of the 349 seats. Led by Ingvar Carlsson, the party returned to power and formed a minority government after the election. The Greens also returned to the Riksdag after a three-year absence. The Moderates slightly improved on their 1991 performance, but the Centre Party, the Liberals and the Christian Democrats all fared poorly, the latter barely holding on to their parliamentary representation.

en.s: The 1994 Hong Kong District Board elections were held on 18 September 1994. Election was held to all 18 districts of Hong Kong, for 346 members from directly elected constituencies with the abolition of the appointed seats under the new electoral arrangements, as the last step of the democratisation by the then Governor Chris Patten before the handover of Hong Kong. Under the Patten's reform package, the voting age was lowered to 18 from 21, appointed members were abolished, and District Board members were given responsibility of filling 10 of the 60 Legislative Council seats through Election Committee constituency in the election next year.

en.s: The 2001 anthrax attacks, also known as Amerithrax from its Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) case name, occurred within the United States over the course of several weeks beginning on September 18, 2001, one week after the September 11 attacks. Letters containing anthrax spores were mailed to several news media offices and two Democratic U.S. Senators, killing five people and infecting 17 others. According to the FBI, the ensuing investigation became "one of the largest and most complex in the history of law enforcement." A major focus in the early years of the investigation was a bio-weapons expert named Steven Hatfill, who was eventually exonerated.

zh.s: 2001年炭疽邮件袭击也称“Amerithrax”，名称来自美国联邦调查局（FBI）的案件代号。袭击始于2001年9月18日，也就是“9·11”袭击一周后，并在接下来几周内陆续发生。装有炭疽芽孢的信件被寄往多家新闻媒体和两名民主党参议员的办公室，造成5人死亡、17人感染。联邦调查局称，后续调查成为执法史上规模最大、最复杂的案件之一。调查早期的重点对象之一是生物武器专家史蒂文·哈特菲尔，后来他被排除嫌疑。

en.s: German federal elections took place on 18 September 2005 to elect the members of the 16th German Bundestag, the federal parliament of Germany. They became necessary after a motion of confidence in Chancellor Gerhard Schröder failed on 1 July. Following the defeat of Schröder's Social Democratic Party (SPD) in a state election, Schröder asked his supporters to abstain in the Bundestag motion in order that it fail and thus trigger an early federal election. The opposition Christian Democratic Union (CDU) and its sister party in Bavaria, the Christian Social Union (CSU), started the federal election campaign with a 21% lead over the SPD in opinion polls.

en.s: The 2010 Honolulu special mayoral election was held on September 18, 2010. The election coincided with Hawaii's primary election. en.s: The last Berlin state election was held on 18 September 2011, to elect members to the Abgeordnetenhaus (House of Deputies) of Berlin. All 141 seats were up for election. Berlin was governed by a coalition between the Social Democratic Party and The Left at the time. Current mayor Klaus Wowereit was the favourite heading into Sunday's election. The SPD won the most seats, 48, despite losing five. The Left also lost three seats, making a renewal of the two parties' red-red coalition impossible. The centre-right Christian Democratic Union (CDU) gained two seats to 39, putting them in second place, while the Greens gained seven to finish third, with 30.

en.s: The 2011 All-Ireland Football Championship final was the 124th event of its kind. The attack was "foiled" by Pakistani military and all militants were killed in state's retaliation, according to official claims. It was the first time that the militants came with a new strategy; to engage the Pakistani military in a long-term battle with excessive ammunition. PAF Camp Badaber is located just about 48 kilometres (30 mi) east of Afghan border.

en.s: The 2016 Uri attack was an attack by four heavily armed terrorists on 18 September 2016, near the town of Uri in the Indian-administered state of Jammu and Kashmir. It was reported as "the deadliest attack on security forces in Kashmir in two decades". No group has claimed responsibility for the attack, though the militant group Jaish-e-Mohammed is suspected of being involved in the planning and execution of the attack. At the time of the attack, the Kashmir Valley region was at the centre of unrest, during which 85 civilians were killed and thousands injured in clashes with security forces.

en.t: 2024 New Jersey's 10th congressional district special election
en.s: The 2024 New Jersey's 10th congressional district special election was held on September 18, 2024, to fill the vacant seat in New Jersey's 10th congressional district. The winner will serve in the United States House of Representatives for the remainder of the 118th United States Congress. The seat became vacant on April 24, 2024, when Donald Payne Jr. died following a heart attack related to complications from diabetes.
